description: This Java class 'CustomerController' is a Spring Boot REST controller managing customer-related endpoints for a banking application. It defines API endpoints for CRUD operations on customer data, such as retrieving all customers, adding a new customer, fetching a specific customer by number, updating customer details, and deleting a customer. The class interacts with a service layer 'BankingServiceImpl' and uses Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for customer management in a banking app, exposing endpoints for CRUD operations.

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/all' to retrieve a list of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/add' to create a new customer.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/{customerNumber}' to fetch customer details by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to '/{customerNumber}' to update customer information.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to '/{customerNumber}' to remove a customer and their accounts.
